# ═══ LISTENABLE / WATCHABLE MIX (Tony's musing, 2026-08-08 — "feels
# possible in a way it didn't just an hour ago") ═══
# The mix as a PODCAST you play in the car; ultimately a generated SHOW.
# Phases:
#   (a) Drivable influence playlist: the music mix's songs + TTS-read
#       interstitials of the card text we already generate. Card copy IS
#       the script; the mix IS the running order. Nearest-term.
#   (b) Media-agnostic rich podcast: original research narration + CITED
#       AUDIO QUOTES stitched end-to-end — the watchable-receipts idea
#       becoming hearable (play the 1978 Dunham clip inside the episode).
#   (c) Dynamically generated video show: the influence mix as a watchable
#       multimedia episode; cards as scenes.
# THE RIGHTS LINE THAT SHAPES ALL THREE: embeds are page-level permission —
# a platform lets you EMBED in a page; it does NOT let you stitch its
# audio/video into a generated artifact. Stitchable inputs are exactly the
# three clean storage cases from the inline-media contemplation: public
# domain (LoC/AAPB-era material), first-party (agent-outreach recordings,
# artist-curated audio), licensed. So (a) works today as app-played
# playlist w/ TTS between PLATFORM-STREAMED songs (nothing stitched);
# (b)/(c) grow with the PD + first-party archive. The tech is near
# (transcripts, TTS, timestamps all exist in-house); rights is the design
# constraint, not capability.

# ═══ GROWTH: TIKTOK-LENGTH INFLUENCE TREES (Tony, 2026-08-08) ═══
# Once Kynda is live/scalable/affordable consumer-facing: generate short
# vertical videos laying out the influence tree of NEW AND EMERGING bands,
# shows, cultural phenomena — awareness engine, phase (d) of the media
# ladder (same stack as the show: cards → script → TTS → video, cut to
# 60-90s). Why it may come FIRST among the media phases:
#   - SPEED IS THE MOAT: album drops Friday, verified influence tree posts
#     Saturday — the pipeline turns a new release into quote-confirmed
#     receipts in hours for ~$1. Nobody else can do it WITH receipts.
#   - EMERGING ARTISTS SELF-DOCUMENT: fresh acts name influences in every
#     interview — harvest is easy where the corpus is otherwise thinnest
#     (recency). And the featured artist is the likeliest sharer: the
#     video hands them a lineage — they amplify it. Distribution flywheel;
#     top of the funnel for "artists curate their own maps."
#   - RECEIPTS AS BRAND: every claim on screen is quote-confirmed — the
#     citation chip IN THE FRAME — vs vibes-based music-tok. The
#     verification ethic IS the differentiator at 15 seconds.
#   - RIGHTS CARVE-OUT: TikTok/Reels carry platform-licensed music
#     libraries — the soundtrack problem is partially solved ON-platform
#     (the artist's own tracks usable in-app), unlike the stitched podcast.
#   - Comment section = hunch queue (Ask Kynda's reader-contribution loop,
#     aimed at the generation that lives there).
# ═══ TOP ITEM (Tony, 2026-08-08): INLINE MEDIA v0 on a demo page ═══
# Watch Cunningham's influences embedded IN the cards; hear Jarrett's
# predecessors. v0 = render existing curated Experience-it doors (many are
# already YouTube/Vimeo urls) as official embed players on ONE demo page
# (Cunningham candidate). ~an afternoon. Principles from the contemplation:
#   - embed ≠ host ≠ steal: official embed APIs are the platform's own
#     distribution; views/ads accrue to the creator. Inline preview,
#     OUTBOUND CREDIT (keep the "watch on YouTube ↗" door visible).
#   - MEDIA PROVENANCE = citation ladder applied to embeds: official
#     channel/archive first-degree, fan upload third. Chip it on the card.
#   - proprietary storage only in three clean cases: public domain
#     (pre-1929 = preservation + differentiation, where platforms are
#     weakest), first-party (agent-outreach recordings, artist-curated
#     maps — the walled garden you're allowed to build because you grew
#     it), licensed (the whale conversations wearing product clothes).
#   - technically an `embed` field on the CLAIM {provider, id, degree,
#     license, TIMESTAMP} — play the 40 seconds of Sacre that Bausch
#     reinterpreted. Verification = oEmbed metadata check (dumb check,
#     no model judgment), tombstone fallback when embeds rot.
#   - ramp: v0 doors-as-players → v1 harvest-time embed candidates →
#     v2 PD self-hosting → v3 licensed/first-party.
